turns.text: Hey Lloyd, just venting for a sec. I tried to debug that ESQL query last night and it was a nightmare. It's such a complex query language where agents frequently make syntax errors (e.g., wildcards) without specific skills.
That sounds incredibly frustrating, Alan. Handling syntax errors without dedicated skills can definitely slow down progress. Did you manage to isolate the specific wildcard issue?
Barely. I think it was an escaping issue with the asterisk. Anyway, unrelated, but can you check if the new mechanical keyboards are back in stock at that shop I mentioned?
I'll take a look at the inventory for those keyboards. While I do that, do you want me to set a reminder to review the ESQL documentation later?
No, I'm too tired for that now. Just let me know about the keyboards. Also, is it supposed to rain tomorrow?
The forecast shows a 40% chance of rain tomorrow. As for the keyboards, I'll have an update for you shortly.
Great, thanks. I'll check back later. Going to make some pasta.
Enjoy your dinner! I'll ping you when I have the keyboard status.
Lloyd, I've been reading this paper titled 'Phase Matters'. It analyzes heterogeneous SoC phase-based inference on Snapdragon 8 Elite. The efficiency gains are pretty interesting.
That is a significant topic in edge computing. Analyzing phase-based inference on the Snapdragon 8 Elite could offer valuable insights for your current hardware benchmarks.
Exactly. I'm thinking of applying some of those phase separation techniques to our mobile AI pipeline. But first, did those keyboards arrive yet?
I checked again, and they are still listed as 'backordered' with an estimated arrival in two weeks. Sorry about that delay.
Ugh, fine. I'll look for an alternative. Also, my internet is acting up. Can you run a quick speed test?
I cannot run a speed test directly from here, but I can guide you to a reliable online tester. Is the connection dropping or just slow?
Just slow. I'll try rebooting the router. Back to the paper, do you have a summary of the phase analysis methods they used?
I can generate a summary of the phase analysis methods from 'Phase Matters' if you provide the specific sections or abstract you'd like me to focus on.
